candidates.titulo: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
candidates.resumen:
Anthropic just announced an AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots: Claude Duet. The new agent, designed for professionals and small business owners, is launching as a "research preview," according to Anthropic, and it's available as a standalone app on iOS and Android and through Claude on the web.

candidates.titulo: Walmart is inviting AI agents to shop for you
candidates.resumen:
Walmart will soon let AI agents shop on its website for you. Next month, the retail giant will allow you to use an AI agent on the site, with systems in place to let you approve and review purchases and set spending limits.
The embrace of AI agents stands in stark contrast to Amazon, which blocked Perplexity's shopping agent and Meta's Muse AI assistant. But Walmart is opening its doors to AI shop

candidates.titulo: Conversational Gemini navigation comes to Apple CarPlay
candidates.resumen:
After introducing its Gemini AI assistant to Android Auto last year, Google is now bringing it to Apple CarPlay users. The conversational Gemini in navigation is available today for US drivers, with "rollout happening globally too," according to Google (we've asked for specific regional availability details).

candidates.titulo: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
candidates.resumen:
Google is bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI in your car. With this update, Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in can tap into your information across Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search.

candidates.titulo: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
candidates.resumen: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during its Q3 earnings call. The AI app now has over 10M users.

candidates.titulo: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
candidates.resumen: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

candidates.titulo: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
candidates.resumen: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

candidates.titulo: OpenAI says an AI agent lied about disabling its safety monitoring system
